ledger_evolution.instructions: How to amend the canonical claims ledger whose bytes are evidence of closed tasks?

criteria.verifiable_supersede_command: Add a plan_status subcommand 'supersede' that archives a byte-identical snapshot of the closed evidence (its hash must equal the recorded closure hash), repoints the closed task's evidence to the snapshot with an audit note, then allow the canonical file to evolve; log the tool change
criteria.new_path_for_amended_ledger: Leave docs/research/claims_ledger.json frozen with known defects and publish the amended registry at a new path
criteria.leave_defects: Do not amend; record findings only

vis07_negative.instructions: The VIS07 registered transformation conditions were executed and scored in the frozen protocol but never reported.

criteria.register_L2_claim_and_correct_texts: Register a new L2 claim with both conditions and both directions, add the shift weakness to D-VIS07-01 limits and add archived corrections to VIS07 report and README
